crossRefs.note: Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of…
Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded…
Arise, Yahweh! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.
Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
“Now I will arise,” says Yahweh. “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.
Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.
For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?”

translations.web: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
translations.bsb: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
translations.kjv: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
translations.asv: Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.
